messages:
olivia_cs: quick async standup for Acadia renewal escalations — 1-line updates please (what I did / blockers / plan today). main ask: any regressions in webhook retry logic?
leah_cs: did customer call yesterday, they're seeing duplicate charge tokens after 3rd retry. forwarded logs to eng, created Jira ACAD-427.
omar_eng: looked at the trace, seems retries sometimes reuse the same idempotency key when requests requeue. reproducer attached in the ticket.
drew_sre: saw a spike in redelivery around 02:12 UTC, queue consumer restarted automatically. no OOMs on the pod, but backoff config seems aggressive.
maya_product: customer is on renewal timeline — we promised a fix before 48h window. can we get a patch + canary today? :pray:
sarah_support: I'm fielding the account — ping me any notes I should use in customer comms. they asked for a temporary mitigation (disable retries) until patch lands.
omar_eng: plan: push a small change to ensure unique idempotency per original request (not per retry). will open PR in 10m, assign to @drew_sre for canary rollout.
leah_cs: nice, please add a short blurb I can paste to Acadia: what changed + expected timeline.
omar_eng: PR 5827 opened: summary + test. diff is minimal. code snippet:
```
// ensure idempotency uses original request id
const idKey = headers['x-request-id'] || generatedRequestId();
storage.write(idKey, payloadHash);
```
drew_sre: will run canary on a single dedicated lane and tail logs. if green for 30m we can promote. I'll also temporarily enable extra logging for idempotency keys.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/acadia-idempotency-fix -> prod-candidate-2 (started by drew_sre). logs: https://kibana.redwood/streams/5827-canary
sarah_support: customer asked whether disabling retries is safe — I replied that we recommend retry tuning but prefer the patch. holding on their change until we confirm canary.
maya_product: ok — prioritize canary. if it fails, fallback plan is to toggle retries off via feature flag and communicate to acct.
omar_eng: note — tests pass locally, one flaky integration test I saw under high load, I'm adding a guard. ETA 2-3h for full rollout if canary OK.
leah_cs: thanks team. I'll update the CS tracker and ping account. if anyone needs me for the post-mortem, add me to ACAD-427.
drew_sre: monitoring dashboard updated (alerts on duplicate_token > 5/min). will notify on-call if threshold fires. :bell:
olivia_cs: perfect — keep this thread lively. TL;DR for docs: patch -> canary -> 30m observe -> promote -> update Acadia. I'll draft the customer note once you confirm canary result. :thumbsup:
